title: normDet of the adjoint: horizontal restriction for surjective maps, zero otherwise
statement:
Let X and Y be finite-dimensional real inner product spaces and P : X → Y a linear map with adjoint P* : Y → X. Let ι : (ker P)^⊥ → X be the inclusion of the orthogonal complement of ker P.
(a) If P is surjective, then normDet(P*) = normDet(P ∘ ι).
(b) If P is not surjective, then normDet(P*) = 0.
Here normDet is Mathlib's LinearMap.normDet and P* is LinearMap.adjoint P.
lean_statement: ∀ {X Y : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [InnerProductSpace ℝ X] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Y] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Y] (P : X →ₗ[ℝ] Y), (Function.Surjective P → (LinearMap.adjoint P).normDet = (P ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker P)ᗮ.subtype).normDet) ∧ (¬ Function.Surjective P → (LinearMap.adjoint P).normDet = 0)
